subject: GCP marketplace: supporting reverse-charge / VAT pass-through for CloudReseller
messages:
From: Sven Berg <sven.berg@cloudreseller.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-ops@partner.gcp.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: Supporting EU reverse-charge for GCP marketplace invoices

Hi Rachel —

Quick background: CloudReseller is implementing pass-through invoicing for GCP Marketplace in several EU countries. Our tax team requires evidence from vendors so our finance team can apply the reverse-charge (VAT) treatment on the reseller invoice. For Redwood this usually means we need: a template invoice showing your legal entity name and VAT number, confirmation you permit invoice pass-through for marketplace listings, and a signed statement of tax residency or W-8/W-9 where applicable.

Can you confirm what Redwood can provide? Specific asks from our tax folks:
- Company legal name and VAT registration (for EU entity used on marketplace listing)
- Sample invoice that shows Redwood as the underlying supplier but billed via the Marketplace reseller
- A short note (signed) confirming Redwood allows pass-through and that Redwood will not charge VAT when reseller applies reverse-charge
- If applicable, which Redwood entity (and address) appears on the GCP billing feed/invoice metadata

We are on a tight renewal timeline with a customer; if we can get evidence this week, we can close their order and move the listing live. Attaching a sample of the invoice format we expect.

Thanks — appreciate any quick guidance.

Best,
Sven
Head of Finance Ops
CloudReseller Inc.

Attachment: CloudReseller_sample_invoice_pass_through.pdf (1 page)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sven Berg <sven.berg@cloudreseller.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 17:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Supporting EU reverse-charge for GCP marketplace invoices

Thanks Sven — good summary. Looping in Vanessa (partnerships) and Karthik (finance) who own marketplace billing and tax evidence. We can do this but need to confirm which Redwood legal entity is on the GCP listing for CloudReseller (we have a couple of entity options across regions). Also: we typically provide a supplier declaration for "invoice pass-through" and an invoice template; W-8/W-9 are US tax forms (W-9 for US payees; W-8 series for non-US). For EU reverse-charge the key items are: vendor VAT number on the supplier line, a statement we will not charge VAT where reseller applies reverse-charge, and a sample invoice matching the marketplace metadata.

Vanessa/Karthik — can you: 1) confirm the legal entity and VAT number that will appear on the GCP metadata for this reseller listing; 2) confirm we can provide a short signed supplier declaration (we have an internal template) and a PDF sample invoice that mirrors what Redwood will show in marketplace reporting? If we need legal sign-off, please flag.

Sven — I’ll follow up with the materials (and a DocuSign link for the supplier declaration) by end of week.

—Rachel
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Supporting EU reverse-charge for GCP marketplace invoices

Thanks Rachel. Quick answers:
- Entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) is the contracting entity on the public GCP listing for this model variant, but for EU billing we use Redwood Inference EU Ltd (VAT GB123456789) for customers in EU/UK where local entity is required.
- VAT: Redwood Inference EU Ltd VAT GB123456789 — confirmed.
- We can provide a supplier declaration confirming pass-through for marketplace resellers; Legal prefers our one-paragraph template and asks that it be countersigned by an authorized Redwood finance approver.
- Sample invoice: finance can produce a PDF that reflects the marketplace flow (supplier line showing Redwood Inference EU Ltd / VAT GB123456789, invoice number, net amounts with VAT field blank and a note: "VAT to be accounted for by recipient under reverse-charge where applicable"). Karthik — can you generate the PDF and attach?

Notes for tax: if CloudReseller wants to treat Redwood as outside-scope for VAT, they must have the reseller relationship documented and the invoice metadata must match the reseller payment flow. Also confirm with the GCP ops team whether the billing feed maps our EU entity in the GCP billing export (we've seen mappings differ by marketplace region).

Vanessa
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none in this internal reply)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sven Berg <sven.berg@cloudreseller.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Supporting EU reverse-charge for GCP marketplace invoices

Hi Sven — attaching the checklist and a sample invoice you can use for your tax files.

What we included:
- Redwood legal entity for EU marketplace entries: Redwood Inference EU Ltd, 45 Camden Street, Dublin, Ireland; VAT: IE98765432F
- Supplier declaration: one-paragraph PDF confirming Redwood allows invoice pass-through and will not charge VAT where reseller applies reverse-charge (signed by our Finance Director).
- Sample invoice: shows Redwood Inference EU Ltd as supplier, lists product lines, net amounts, and the invoice footnote: "Reverse-charge: recipient to account for VAT under Article 194 (or local equivalent). No VAT charged by Redwood."
- W-9/W-8: not required for EU reverse-charge evidence — but if CloudReseller needs W-8BEN-E for their US accounting setup we can provide the completed W-8 form upon request (note: W-9 is for US payees only).

Attachments (stubs): redwood_w9_w8_checklist.pdf, CloudReseller_sample_invoice_pass_through.pdf

Next steps: 1) Sven — confirm the invoice template matches your tax team needs; 2) Vanessa — if Legal needs to adjust the supplier declaration language, please loop them in and Karthik will coordinate the signature.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_w9_w8_checklist.pdf (1 page), CloudReseller_sample_invoice_pass_through.pdf (1 page)
